findings_qualitative.value: Spherical X-ray-centred model leaves a SE residual; a free-centroid ellipsoidal model removes significant residuals.

evidence.quote: the residual amplitude of the SZ effect to the south-east is dramatically reduced when shifting the centroid away from the X-ray peak

claims.hypothesis: Is the SE SZ excess a strong shock-induced overpressure?
claims.experiment: Fit spherical gNFW at X-ray peak vs free ellipsoidal model
claims.result: Spherical model leaves a SE residual; ellipsoidal model leaves none significant
claims.finding: Excess partly geometric; pressure may be more regular

evidence.quote: there is no strong evidence of shock-induced perturbations in the pressure distribution.

evidence.quote: are in good agreement out to $\sim$1 Mpc

claims.hypothesis: SE structure is isobaric vs adiabatic
